market_question: Will ByteDance have the highest IPO Market Cap 2026?
reasoning: ByteDance is one of the most valuable private companies (~$200B) and is reportedly considering an IPO. If it lists in 2026, it is very likely to be the highest-capitalized IPO of the year, as few private firms are larger. The market-implied probability of ~0.2% severely underrates this chance, given a realistic ~10–12% probability of a ByteDance IPO and a high conditional probability that it would lead all 2026 IPOs.
evidence_points: ByteDance valued at ~$200B in recent secondary transactions, making it a top‑3 global unicorn.
Persistent reports that ByteDance is preparing for an IPO (Hong Kong being the most likely venue) after years of delays.
Few credible challengers for the highest IPO market cap in 2026: SpaceX is unlikely to IPO soon, and other large private firms (Stripe, OpenAI) have significantly lower valuations.
sources_consulted: News reports on ByteDance IPO speculation (Reuters, Bloomberg, FT)
General knowledge of unicorn IPO pipeline
